user.title: Virtual Inverter Setup
user.description: Give your virtual inverter a name and configure the HTTP server that the Wattpilot will connect to.

data_description.name: Used as the mDNS hostname (e.g. 'my-inverter' → my-inverter.local). Lowercase letters and hyphens only.
data_description.system_name: Shown in the Wattpilot pairing screen (e.g. 'MyHome'). Defaults to the inverter name if left blank.
data_description.port: Port for the Fronius Solar API HTTP server (default: 80). Use a port above 1024 if HA lacks permission to bind 80.
data_description.update_interval: How often to refresh sensor values in seconds (default: 10).

grid.title: Grid Configuration
grid.description: Map your electricity meter sensor. Enable 'Configure per-phase sensors' if your meter provides per-phase data for Wattpilot load balancing.

data_description.p_grid_dual_mode: Enable if your meter provides separate import and export readings instead of a single signed value.
data_description.p_grid_sensor: Power at your electricity meter. Negative = exporting to grid, Positive = importing from grid.
data_description.p_grid_sensor_pos: Power being imported from the grid (positive values only).
data_description.p_grid_sensor_neg: Power being exported to the grid (positive values only — will be treated as negative).
data_description.p_grid_invert: Enable if your sensor reports export as positive — this flips the sign.
data_description.grid_phases: Match your electrical supply. Affects how load balancing is calculated.
data_description.grid_ct_rating: Main circuit breaker rating in amps. Wattpilot uses this to prevent overloading. Default: 32A.
data_description.configure_per_phase: Shows additional steps to map per-phase power, current, voltage, power factor, and reactive power sensors.

generation.title: PV & Battery
generation.description: Map your solar generation, battery, and house load sensors. All fields are optional — leave blank if not available.

data_description.p_pv_sensor: Total solar panel output in watts. Should always be a positive value.
data_description.p_pv_invert: Enable if your solar sensor reports negative values during generation.
data_description.p_akku_dual_mode: Enable if your battery reports charge and discharge as separate positive-value sensors.
data_description.p_akku_sensor: Battery charge/discharge power. Positive = charging, Negative = discharging.
data_description.p_akku_sensor_pos: Power going into the battery (positive values only).
data_description.p_akku_sensor_neg: Power coming out of the battery (positive values only — will be treated as negative).
data_description.p_akku_invert: Enable if your battery sensor sign is reversed.
data_description.p_load_sensor: Total household power consumption. Should be a negative value.
data_description.p_load_invert: Enable if your consumption sensor reports positive values.
data_description.soc_sensor: Battery percentage 0–100%. Used by the Wattpilot for battery threshold charging decisions.

advanced.title: Per-Phase Load Balancing — Phase A
advanced.description: Phase A sensors for Wattpilot load balancing accuracy. Leave blank for any sensors your meter does not provide — values will be derived automatically.

data_description.p_grid_phase_a: Phase A grid power. Leave blank to auto-split total grid power equally across phases.
data_description.i_grid_phase_a: Phase A grid current in amps. Derived from P/V if not set.
data_description.v_grid_phase_a: Phase A grid voltage. Defaults to 240V if not set.
data_description.power_factor_phase_a: Phase A power factor from your Smart Meter. Improves load balancing accuracy.
data_description.q_grid_phase_a: Phase A reactive power from your Smart Meter. Improves apparent power accuracy.

three_phase.title: Per-Phase Load Balancing — Phases B & C
three_phase.description: Phases B and C sensors for three-phase load balancing. Leave blank for any sensors your meter does not provide.

data_description.p_grid_phase_b: Phase B grid power. Leave blank to auto-split equally.
data_description.p_grid_phase_c: Phase C grid power. Leave blank to auto-split equally.
data_description.i_grid_phase_b: Phase B grid current. Derived from P/V if not set.
data_description.i_grid_phase_c: Phase C grid current. Derived from P/V if not set.
data_description.v_grid_phase_b: Phase B grid voltage. Defaults to 240V if not set.
data_description.v_grid_phase_c: Phase C grid voltage. Defaults to 240V if not set.
data_description.power_factor_phase_b: Phase B power factor from your Smart Meter.
data_description.power_factor_phase_c: Phase C power factor from your Smart Meter.
data_description.q_grid_phase_b: Phase B reactive power from your Smart Meter.
data_description.q_grid_phase_c: Phase C reactive power from your Smart Meter.

modbus.title: Advanced Options
modbus.description: Optionally emulate a Fronius Smart Meter IP over Modbus TCP. Useful if you have a real Fronius SnapIN inverter on the same network that needs a grid meter.

data_description.modbus_enabled: Emulate a Fronius Smart Meter IP via Modbus TCP so a real SnapIN inverter can use HA as its grid meter.
data_description.modbus_port: Modbus TCP port (default: 502 — use 5020 if HA lacks permission to bind port 502).
data_description.modbus_address: Modbus unit ID for the Smart Meter IP (default: 240). Only change if running multiple instances.

error.port_in_use: Port is already in use. Try a different port.

abort.already_configured: An inverter with this name is already configured.
